messages.subject: sex as addcovar/Xcovar additive effect
parts: If sex is a covariate in addcovar, is it redundant to include it in Xcovar? I expect so. The help file language implies it. Just want to confirm. Thanks.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] sex as addcovar/Xcovar additive effect

Yes, Xcovar is for additional covariates to be used with the X chromosome under the null.
